findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "change_plan" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_checkout · Private data: upload_logo, create_checkout, change_plan · Public sink: upload_logo · Destructive: delete_background, upload_logo, delete_logo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_checkout · Private data: upload_logo, create_checkout, change_plan · Public sink: upload_logo · Destructive: delete_background, upload_logo, delete_logo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
